# FutureTalent
> FutureTalent is an AI-powered job board and scraper engine designed to discover, optimize, and present remote, hybrid, and on-site job listings worldwide, alongside career resources and news.

## WebMCP AI Agent Tools
FutureTalent supports the WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) standard. If your agent is running in a WebMCP-capable browser environment, you can invoke the following tools directly via `navigator.modelContext`:

*   `search_jobs({ search, category, remote_type, limit, offset })`: Search and filter active job listings.
*   `get_job_details({ id })`: Retrieve the complete details and full description of a specific job listing.
*   `get_categories()`: Get all job categories and their active job counts.
*   `get_blog_posts({ limit, offset })`: Get recent articles and career guides from the blog.

## Core Navigation URLs
AI agents can navigate or scrape the following key paths directly:
*   [Jobs Search Directory](https://www.futuretalent.online/jobs): Listing page supporting `?search=X`, `?category=Y`, and `?page=Z` query parameters.
*   [Companies Directory](https://www.futuretalent.online/companies): Directory of companies offering active jobs.
*   [Career Blog](https://www.futuretalent.online/blog): Articles and remote work guides.
*   [About Us](https://www.futuretalent.online/about): Core details about FutureTalent.
*   [Contact](https://www.futuretalent.online/contact): Support email and contact options.
*   [Sitemap](https://www.futuretalent.online/sitemap.xml): Complete, dynamic XML sitemap listing all jobs, articles, and companies.

## Structured Metadata
All job details pages (`/jobs/[id]`) contain schema-structured metadata:
*   **JSON-LD JobPosting**: Exposes standard `JobPosting` schema (title, company, description, datePosted, validThrough, employmentType, location) for Google Jobs indexer compliance.

## Optional Reference Pages
*   [Privacy Policy](https://www.futuretalent.online/privacy)
*   [Terms of Service](https://www.futuretalent.online/terms)
